email@9f10228f.name: email
email@9f10228f.description: Mailpit mailcatcher wired to RC's SMTP. Every email RC sends — password resets, invites, verification, notification and 2FA mail — is captured at http://localhost:8025 instead of leaving the machine. Pair with --seed for users with verified emails.

params_help.verification: require email verification on new accounts (default false)

notes: Mailpit (EVERY email RC sends, for ALL users, lands here): http://localhost:8025
— one shared inbox; tell users apart by the To: column.
Quick SMTP check: Admin → Email → 'Send test email', then open Mailpit.
Email-2FA is ON globally, but RC only enforces it on VERIFIED emails:
seeded users (alice/…) get the OTP flow (code in Mailpit); admin is
unverified so it logs in plain. houston's own token/api/seed calls
fetch any required code from Mailpit automatically.
Seeded users (--seed) are created with verified emails, ready for 2FA.

# Generated by houston. Do not edit by hand -- re-run `houston up`.
# Traefik file provider: load-balance across the rocketchat-1..N instances.
http:
  routers:
    rocketchat:
      rule: "PathPrefix(`/`)"
      entryPoints: [web]
      service: rocketchat
  services:
    rocketchat:
      loadBalancer:
        healthCheck:
          path: /api/info
          interval: "10s"
          timeout: "5s"
        sticky:
          cookie:
            name: rc_lb
        servers:
          - url: "http://rocketchat-1:3000"
          - url: "http://rocketchat-2:3000"
notes: Verify the mesh (lists every connected instance):
houston api --name <name> GET /api/v1/instances.get
Open two different instance URLs (shown above) in separate browsers,
post in one and watch it arrive in the other (cross-instance real-time).

s3_minio@15fee594.description: MinIO S3-compatible storage wired as RC's file upload backend (bucket 'my.bucket', console :9001). Default proxies downloads through RC; --set presigned=true for real presigned URLs.

entrypoint: until mc alias set local http://minio:9000 houston houston-secret; do sleep 1; done; mc mb -p local/my.bucket

params_help.presigned: browser fetches presigned MinIO URLs (default false; needs /etc/hosts line)
params_help.s3_host: hostname the BROWSER reaches MinIO on in presigned mode (default 'minio', which needs a hosts entry and only works on this machine)

notes: MinIO console: http://localhost:9001  (houston / houston-secret)
— bucket 'my.bucket' is created automatically; watch uploads land in it.
Upload any file/image in RC; it goes to MinIO instead of GridFS.
PRESIGNED MODE: the browser fetches files straight from MinIO, so add
this line to /etc/hosts (needs sudo):
That entry points at THIS machine, so the browser has to be on it. From
another machine, re-create with:  --bind 0.0.0.0 --set s3_host=<this host>
Remove the line to reproduce the classic 'presigned URL unreachable'
ticket symptom (uploads work, previews/downloads break).
kubernetes_manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: minio
  labels: &id001
    app: houston-minio
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: houston
    houston.io/component: minio
    houston.io/repro: __HOUSTON_NAME__
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: houston-minio
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: *id001
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: minio
        image: docker.io/pgsty/minio:RELEASE.2026-08-04T00-00-00Z
        ports:
        - containerPort: 9000
        - containerPort: 9001
        env:
        - name: MINIO_ROOT_USER
          value: houston
        - name: MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD
          value: houston-secret
        args:
        - server
        - /data
        - --console-address
        - :9001
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /minio/health/ready
            port: 9000
          initialDelaySeconds: 3
          periodSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 40
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: minio
  labels:
    app: houston-minio
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: houston
    houston.io/component: minio
    houston.io/repro: __HOUSTON_NAME__
    houston.io/ui-port: '9000'
spec:
  selector:
    app: houston-minio
  ports:
  - name: p9000
    port: 9000
    targetPort: 9000
  - name: p9001
    port: 9001
    targetPort: 9001
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: minio-console
  labels:
    app: houston-minio
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: houston
    houston.io/component: minio
    houston.io/repro: __HOUSTON_NAME__
    houston.io/ui-port: '9001'
    houston.io/ui-deployment: minio
spec:
  selector:
    app: houston-minio
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 9001
    targetPort: 9001
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: minio-init
  labels: &id001
    app: houston-minio-init
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: houston
    houston.io/component: minio-init
    houston.io/repro: __HOUSTON_NAME__
spec:
  backoffLimit: 10
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: *id001
    spec:
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
      containers:
      - name: minio-init
        image: docker.io/pgsty/mc:RELEASE.2026-08-04T00-00-00Z
        command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - until mc alias set local http://minio:9000 houston houston-secret; do sleep
          2; done; mc mb -p local/my.bucket

saml@034f592b.description: Keycloak IdP with a generated SAML realm (5 users user1..user5, password=username). Click 'Keycloak SSO', log in as user1/user1. Keycloak admin at http://localhost:8081 (admin/admin, realm 'houston').
files: saml/keycloak-realm.json

params_help.idp_host: hostname YOUR BROWSER reaches Keycloak on (default localhost; set it when the browser is not on this machine)

notes: SAML sends your BROWSER to http://localhost:8081 — that address has
to resolve and be reachable from wherever the browser is running.
It is 'localhost', so the browser must be on THIS machine. From another
machine, re-create with:  --bind 0.0.0.0 --set idp_host=<this host>
(Keycloak refuses a request that arrives on any other name.)
Keycloak admin console: http://localhost:8081  (admin / admin)
Your SAML users live in the 'houston' realm, NOT 'master' (the
default view). Switch the realm dropdown (top-left) to 'houston', or open Users directly:
http://localhost:8081/admin/master/console/#/houston/users
('temporary admin' banner on master is normal Keycloak dev mode — ignore it)

    houston.io/repro: __HOUSTON_NAME__
    houston.io/ui-port: '8081'

apiVersion: apps/v1

metadata:

  labels: &id001
    app: houston-keycloak
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: houston
    houston.io/component: keycloak
    houston.io/repro: __HOUSTON_NAME__
    houston.io/ui-port: '8081'
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: houston-keycloak
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: *id001
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: keycloak
        image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.0
        args:
        - start-dev
        - --import-realm
        env:
        - name: KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME
          value: admin
        - name: KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD
          value: admin
        - name: KC_PROXY_HEADERS
          value: xforwarded
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /realms/master
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 10
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 60
        volumeMounts:
        - name: realm
          mountPath: /opt/keycloak/data/import/houston-realm.json
          subPath: houston-realm.json
      volumes:
      - name: realm
        configMap:
          name: keycloak-realm

saml@5e9244db.description: Keycloak IdP with a generated SAML realm (2 users user1..user2, password=username). Click 'Keycloak SSO', log in as user1/user1. Keycloak admin at http://localhost:8081 (admin/admin, realm 'houston').
files: saml/keycloak-realm.json

params_help.idp_host: hostname YOUR BROWSER reaches Keycloak on (default localhost; set it when the browser is not on this machine)

notes: SAML sends your BROWSER to http://localhost:8081 — that address has
to resolve and be reachable from wherever the browser is running.
It is 'localhost', so the browser must be on THIS machine. From another
machine, re-create with:  --bind 0.0.0.0 --set idp_host=<this host>
(Keycloak refuses a request that arrives on any other name.)
Keycloak admin console: http://localhost:8081  (admin / admin)
Your SAML users live in the 'houston' realm, NOT 'master' (the
default view). Switch the realm dropdown (top-left) to 'houston', or open Users directly:
http://localhost:8081/admin/master/console/#/houston/users
('temporary admin' banner on master is normal Keycloak dev mode — ignore it)
